summary: Scan of the signed WA/2011/192 six-month accelerated stability report for Esmervane Pharmaceuticals (EP19 capsule blend, lot L02), May 2012. Assay remained within specification; a degradant grew at 40 °C/75% RH. Handwritten comment on the moisture barrier and an approval stamp.

title_block.title: STABILITY REPORT: EP19 CAPSULE BLEND, LOT L02
title_block.subtitle: Six-month accelerated data

blocks.p: 1.1 This report gives results for lot L02 of the EP19 capsule blend stored under the protocol conditions up to six months. Storage started on 07/11/2011.
2.1 Initial assay {{PRJ0086:stability.t0_assay}}% of label claim. Results to {{PRJ0086:stability.last_timepoint_months}} months are tabulated below.

3.1 Assay and total impurities remain within specification at 25 °C/60% RH and 30 °C/65% RH. At 40 °C/75% RH the RRT 0.86 degradant increases with time, consistent with moisture-driven hydrolysis. 3.2 Conclusions are limited to the tested interval.

scan.handwriting: Moisture barrier? discuss w/ client - AP
